articles.summary: OppFi Inc. (NYSE: OPFI) ("OppFi" or the "Company"), a tech-enabled digital finance platform that partners with banks to offer financial products and services to everyday Americans, today announced that, at this time, it has withdrawn its applications to the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency ("OCC"), the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System ("Federal Reserve") and the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation ("FDIC") related to the proposed acquisition of BNCCORP, Inc. (OTCQX: BNCC) and its wholly owned subsidiary, BNC National Bank (collectively "BNC"). OppFi proactively engaged with federal regulators before entering into the BNC transaction and has diligently responded to extensive information requests from the OCC, Federal Reserve and FDIC throughout the application process.
